crouching.notes: Intentional body-height changes must not be rescaled.

prop_held.notes: Prop ownership is part of state, not decoration.

edge_peeking.notes: Requires screen-edge/ledge positioning and a dedicated exit.

migration.idPolicy: Animation IDs are permanent snake_case identifiers. Replace frames in-place only through a manifest version bump; never rename a published ID silently.
migration.replacementPolicy: New sequence must pass 128x128 RGBA/alpha/path/checksum validation and retain compatible posture/prop semantics or declare a breaking major manifest version.
migration.isolatedPosePolicy: Audit-only until explicitly approved in the Animation Laboratory and assigned a stable runtime ID.
